purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Koliwar

queries.query: Koliwar Bihar official cadastral map parcel cadastre registry Bihar Bhumi Bhu Naksha Koilwar
queries.result: First-party discovery found Bihar Bhumi, the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms gateway, and BhuNaksha Bihar, the Directorate of Land Records & Survey cadastral map viewer. The viewer exposed Koilwar hierarchy and a public WMS-backed map, but no public vector parcel geometry response was identified.

queries.query: कोईलवर बिहार आधिकारिक भू नक्शा भूलेख खसरा खतौनी रजिस्ट्रार
queries.result: First-party discovery again identified Bihar Bhumi and BhuNaksha Bihar. The official viewer’s Hindi labels exposed कोईलवर as a Koilwar mauza and offered Revisional Survey and Cadastral Survey choices; no public vector parcel geometry endpoint was found.

registryEvidence.basis: Bihar Government’s Revenue and Land Reforms Department identifies Bihar Bhumi as its land-record gateway and links Bhu-Naksha; the first-party BhuNaksha viewer identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar, and served the Koilwar hierarchy including mauza कोईलवर.
registryEvidence.localCustodianScope: State/local cadastral service evidence is present for Bihar and the Bhojpur–Koilwar administrative hierarchy. This is custodian and service evidence, not proof of complete citywide parcel coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official Bihar Government Revenue and Land Reforms gateway lists Bhu-Manचित्र/Bhu-Naksha, land records, and the Directorate of Land Records & Survey.
Official BhuNaksha Bihar viewer states it is cadastral mapping software for digitized cadastral maps and identifies the Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar.
Current viewer HTML exposed District 29 Bhojpur, Sub Division 01 Ara Sadar, Circle 02 Koilwar, and the कोईलवर mauza option with RS/CS survey choices.
Official Directorate of Land Records & Survey page lists Online Map and Online Revenue Records services.

remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point is outside the retrieved कोईलवर sheet extent, and the blank point lookup must not be interpreted as citywide absence. The viewer may require another sheet/mauza or may expose geometry only through rendered WMS. No login, credentials, CAPTCHA bypass, TLS exception, owner/address/contact/titleholder/personal/tax/account fields, or source integration was used. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
